lines.1: I clattered out a sentence on the keyboard.
lines.3: Ah, what was this ticklish feeling of superiority?
lines.4: ...It felt like showing off my soccer skills to an elementary school kid and hearing how awesome I was.
lines.5: 「Fukahire types one-handed, but this is the usual way.」
lines.6: 「How do you produce the letters? You type them by their romanized readings, correct?」
lines.7: 「Just watch the keyboard closely while you type.」
lines.8: 「You did not look at it at all. I want to do it that way too.」
lines.9: 「Your own rule is that strength comes from training, and there are no shortcuts, right?」
lines.10: 「This isn't so easy that you can master it in an instant. You'll need some practice with typing software.」
lines.11: 「I-I see. First I must grow accustomed to it.」
lines.12: 「Right. Whatever you want to learn, you need to get comfortable with computers first.」
lines.16: Otome glared at the keyboard as if it had murdered her parents.
lines.17: 「Y-you don't need to get so worked up.」
lines.23: She was usually so rosy and full of life.
lines.28: 「So it's only digital things that make you sick.」
lines.29: No wonder she did not own a cell phone.
lines.30: What an inconvenient person to be in the information age.
lines.31: 「A-anyway, if you're sick, let's stop. This can't be good for you.」
lines.32: 「No. At least let me finish my name... I must complete what I started...」
lines.33: Otome forced her fingers across the keys through sheer willpower.
lines.37: 「You did! You typed your own name!」
lines.39: We were absolutely not making fun of her.
lines.40: I made my way to the library building.
lines.41: I figured I should learn how to teach computers properly.
lines.42: Otome had probably learned her lesson yesterday, but just in case.
lines.43: 'Computer Skills Even a Warrior Can Master: Batting and Baserunning'
